CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(Inventory_Product__c), "Billed only", IF(AND(NFY_Ship_From__r.NFY_Code__c = "FACTORY", BLANKVALUE(Quantity_Allocated__c, 0) < BLANKVALUE(Quantity_Ordered__c, 0)), "Factory drop-ship", IF(BLANKVALUE(Quantity_Allocated__c, 0) >= BLANKVALUE(Quantity_Ordered__c, 0), "Fully assigned", IF(BLANKVALUE(Quantity_Allocated__c, 0) > 0, "Partially assigned", "No stock"))))
